turns.question: Of the customers who signed up in August 2026, what share had bought from us by 10 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of a signup cohort that had bought by a given date; the closest, the Signup-to-first-order rate (first order within 30 days of signing up), came back empty for the August 2026 cohort, while the closest counts are 11 Signups in August 2026 (1-31 August) and 4 Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) among those August 2026 signups with orders from 1 August to 10 October 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
